title: Knight and Glowing Earth
description: A lone knight in copper armor kneels in a dark field at night, reaching toward a large glowing orb depicting planet Earth. Ethereal purple jellyfish float in the air around him while a giant luminous jellyfish hovers in the starry sky above an old iron gate and wooden fence.
